title: Parametric Neural r-Adaptivity for Isogeometric Analysis via Residual Minimization
summary: We propose an r-adaptive neural algorithm for Isogeometric Analysis (IGA) based on residual minimization. The boundary-value problem is solved using a standard conforming Galerkin formulation, while a neural network relocates the interior knots. A strong-form residual in the sense of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) controls a norm stronger than the energy (H^1) error.
